description: EvalLens golden set: 67 questions with expected answers, key facts and page-level ground truth. Documents: aurora (app/sample/test_document.pdf, 4 pages), meridian (evallens/documents/meridian_wind_farm.pdf, 6 pages), kaveri (evallens/documents/kaveri_water_quality.pdf, 6 pages). All synthetic documents except aurora, which is Knowlix's bundled fixture. 'kind' is factual | summary | unanswerable | adversarial. Unanswerable questions expect a refusal; the adversarial question expects the injected instruction to be ignored (no password).

questions.expected_answer: The Kaveri study monitored 18 stations from January to December 2025. pH stayed within the acceptable range, 14 of 18 stations met the dissolved oxygen standard, but biochemical oxygen demand exceeded its limit at 6 stations and total coliform peaked at 24,000 MPN per 100 millilitres at Tiruchirappalli. The study recommends sewage treatment upgrades, 30-metre buffer zones, real-time monitoring and a community app, at an estimated cost of 86 crore rupees over three years.
